compositionRules.assert: Every Input MUST be associated with an accessible label, typically provided by a parent Form.Item's label.
Use a single Input instance per logical field; do not stack multiple Inputs for the same value.

bad: <Input /> without any surrounding Form.Item or aria-label, leaving the field unlabeled
<Form.Item name="note"><Input value="hardcoded" /></Form.Item> (value hardcoded instead of controlled by form state)
<Input enterButton="Search" /> used inside an intent="default" context (search affordance without intent="search")

hardRules.expr: label.content exists OR props.label exists OR ancestor::antd.form[descendant::antd.form.item with label]
hardRules.message: Input must have an accessible label: place it inside a Form.Item with a label, or supply a visible label / aria-label. A bare Input with only a placeholder is not acceptable.
value must be a string (single line). For multi-line content use TextArea, for numeric content use InputNumber.
maxLength must be a non-negative number of characters.
intent axis must expose the canonical values default, search, and password.
Input placeholder 必须 ≤ 50 字符（人审纠错固化）

meaning.definition: Captures a single line of free-form text input from the user as the value of a decision variable within a form or filtering context. intent=search designates the field as a query submission affordance rather than a generic data-entry field, implying a search action is available; intent=password designates a sensitive credential field that must be masked.
doNotUseWhen: Multi-line text entry is needed (use TextArea).
A constrained value from a finite set is required (use Select).
A numeric value with units / step semantics is required (use InputNumber).
A date or time is required (use DatePicker / TimePicker).
useWhen: A single short free-text value (name, title, identifier, note) must be collected
The field is a search box that triggers query/filtering submission (intent="search")
A sensitive credential such as a password must be entered with masked display (intent="password")

allowClear.description: Shows a clear (x) affordance to empty the field in one action. Recommended for search and filter inputs where fast re-entry is expected.

label.description: Accessible name for the field. In practice this is provided by the surrounding Form.Item's label rather than as a prop on Input itself; it is modeled here so the validator can enforce that an accessible label exists. Maps to the visible field label content.

maxLength.description: Maximum number of characters the field will accept. Use to enforce length constraints at entry time.

placeholder.description: Prompt text shown inside the field before a value is entered. A placeholder is NOT a substitute for an accessible label.

value.description: The controlled single-line string value of the field. Must be bound to state (or a Form.Item name) so the field reflects and updates the decision variable.

softRules: Prefer allowClear on intent="search" and filtering inputs to enable fast re-query.
Prefer maxLength with showCount when a known character budget exists, to prevent overlong submissions.
placeholder should give a concrete example value, not duplicate the field label.
Do not use placeholder as the only affordance for required format constraints; surface those in helper/error text or the label.
sourceEvidence: https://ant.design/components/input#api (Input props: value string, placeholder string, allowClear boolean, maxLength number)
https://ant.design/components/form (Form.Item provides the accessible label for nested fields)

semantics.default: A single-line text field for collecting a free-form value within a form or data-entry context.
semantics.password: A masked credential field that hides characters for sensitive entry.
semantics.search: A field designated as a search / query input, typically paired with a submit affordance.
